nodes.label: Ad Types
nodes.rationale: Ad types must differ: paid post/story/reel, barter, affiliate commission, visit-based QR, UGC.

nodes.label: Affiliate Links & Discount Codes
nodes.rationale: Auto-generate custom affiliate links or discount codes per creator to track actual sales.

nodes.label: AI-Generated Creator Bio/Portfolio
nodes.rationale: Bio generated from the creator profile via an AI agent.

nodes.label: Analytics & ROI Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Brands want to know what the ad achieved; platform pulls reach/engagement/clicks post-publish into a professional report.

nodes.label: Anonymous Brand Reviews
nodes.rationale: Creators anonymously write experiences with companies to warn fellow creators.

nodes.label: Barter Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Small businesses offer free products/services for an ad, documented by an in-app contract to guarantee the creator publishes.

nodes.label: Barter Digital Catalog
nodes.rationale: Companies upload products/services available for exchange so creators pick what suits them for content.

nodes.label: Brand/Merchant Actor
nodes.rationale: Signs up by phone only, then chooses company or store type, name, Facebook/Instagram, and industry.

nodes.label: Exclusive Brand Clubs
nodes.rationale: Creator joins a brand's elite list to get fixed monthly retainers as a permanent brand ambassador.

nodes.label: Campaign Brief Builder
nodes.rationale: Guides merchants who may not know how to request an ad to specify content type, mandatory keywords, and forbidden mentions.

nodes.label: Collab Network / Group Collaboration
nodes.rationale: Future feature letting two creators merge and submit a joint package for one campaign to increase acceptance.

nodes.label: Content Review System (Drafts)
nodes.rationale: Creator uploads video/image as a draft in-app instead of sending via WhatsApp (which reduces quality), so brand can review and approve before publishing.

nodes.label: Automated Contracts
nodes.rationale: On approval, platform generates a simplified legal PDF contract (publish date, story duration, refund terms) to prevent disputes and protect both parties.

nodes.label: Creator Actor
nodes.rationale: Requires a professional (Creator or Business) account linked to a Facebook page; signs up by phone only.

nodes.label: Dispute Resolution
nodes.rationale: All agreement and publishing must happen in-app so records are reviewable by support when a dispute arises.

nodes.label: Dynamic Profiles
nodes.rationale: Replaces traditional portfolio by linking social accounts to surface real engagement stats and audience segmentation automatically.

nodes.label: Escrow System
nodes.rationale: Trust and money is the biggest pain point; brand pays platform upfront, funds held until creator publishes and system confirms, then released.

nodes.label: Escrow Fund Release Split
nodes.rationale: Deposited ad amount is frozen; 30% transferred on start, remainder released after publish minus the platform's percentage commission.

nodes.label: Free Launch Then Commission Strategy
nodes.rationale: Offer service fully free at first to organize the market and attract sign-ups, then gradually activate commissions once users depend on the platform.

nodes.label: Hyper-Local Filtering
nodes.rationale: Search creators by governorate/city — essential for physical restaurants and shops.

nodes.label: Instant Cash-out
nodes.rationale: Creator withdraws earnings instantly to Sham Cash for a small fee instead of waiting for the usual weekly transfer.

nodes.label: Local E-Wallet Payment Integration
nodes.rationale: Brand tops up via local payment services (e.g. Syriatel Cash, Sham Cash) sending to the platform wallet number.

nodes.label: Local Rate Index
nodes.rationale: Shows creators the prevailing market average for similar creator tiers (without revealing identities) so they don't underprice.

nodes.label: Smart Matchmaking
nodes.rationale: System recommends best-fit creators from campaign details, or lets creators apply to open campaigns like freelance platforms.

nodes.label: Notification Settings & City Alerts
nodes.rationale: Alert creators in the same city to apply quickly after a client posts a campaign; configurable notification receiving.

nodes.label: Offline Event Booking
nodes.rationale: Companies book a creator by the hour to attend a store opening, ribbon-cutting, or live on-ground event coverage with an hourly rate.

nodes.label: Deal Pipeline / State Machine
nodes.rationale: Turns the ad-hoc agreement into ordered programmatic states to prevent overlap or tampering.

nodes.label: Sada All-in-One Creator Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Market is fragmented; creators and brands juggle email, WhatsApp, analytics and payment apps for one deal — consolidating into one platform is the core value.

nodes.label: Profile Comparison Matrix
nodes.rationale: Lets a client compare up to 3 creators' numbers, prices and engagement on one chart before hiring.

nodes.label: Proof-of-Publish Link Verification
nodes.rationale: Creator submits post/story link as proof; system verifies it, then releases escrow funds.

nodes.label: Visit-Based QR Tracking
nodes.rationale: Generate a creator-specific QR that customers scan for a discount so the merchant knows how many visits the creator drove.

nodes.label: Saved Rate Cards
nodes.rationale: Save preset price packages (e.g. 3 stories bundle, reel+story) to send clients with one tap.

nodes.label: Refund Pipeline
nodes.rationale: If creator breaches or delays publishing, funds auto-return to the merchant wallet without argument.

nodes.label: Smart Rate Calculator
nodes.rationale: Future tool suggesting a fair price based on real views and market demand so creators don't undersell.

nodes.label: UGC Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Hire creators to shoot videos/products without publishing on the creator's account, for the brand to use as its own paid ads.

nodes.label: Vacation Mode
nodes.rationale: Temporarily stop receiving offers and notify companies of absence without hurting ranking or rating.

nodes.label: Digital Wallet
nodes.rationale: Both parties need a wallet; brands deposit and pay, creators withdraw only.

nodes.label: Primitive Components (Box/Text/Pressable/Card)
nodes.rationale: New components must use primitives instead of raw RN View/Text

nodes.label: Theme System
nodes.rationale: All visual values go through the theme; no raw numbers for spacing, fonts, colors, radii

nodes.label: Run iOS (Production)
nodes.rationale: Uses ENVFILE=.env.production to select production environment config

nodes.label: Run iOS (Staging)
nodes.rationale: Uses ENVFILE=.env.staging to select staging environment config

nodes.label: Design Dials (variance/motion/density)
nodes.rationale: Optional sliders tune design-system output without changing the query; leaving a dial unset keeps that part unchanged.

nodes.label: Design System Generation
nodes.rationale: Always start with --design-system to get comprehensive recommendations with reasoning before deep-diving domains.

nodes.label: Master + Overrides Persistence Pattern
nodes.rationale: Page-specific override files override the Master file for hierarchical retrieval across sessions.

nodes.label: ESLint no-restricted-imports enforcement
nodes.rationale: Import boundaries and dependency direction are lint-enforced; violations fail npm run lint.

nodes.label: 01 — Domain-Driven Architecture
nodes.rationale: Dependency direction is one-way (app→domains→shared→core) to keep bounded contexts isolated and prevent core from depending on business logic; enforced by ESLint.

nodes.label: Gamification & Status Badges
nodes.rationale: Public badges and ranking (fastest responder, 0% delay, top 10 in a sector) raise a creator's ranking and visibility to big brands.

nodes.label: Multi-Tier Mutual Rating
nodes.rationale: Rate not just by stars but on 4 criteria (timeliness, shooting quality, communication flexibility, actual results); both sides rate each other to raise market quality.

nodes.label: Bootsplash Logo
nodes.rationale: App bootsplash logo image (rendered as blank/white, transparent background)

nodes.label: Bootsplash Logo (@1.5x)
nodes.rationale: App bootsplash logo asset rendered at 1.5x density; appears as white/transparent artwork used on splash screen

nodes.label: Bootsplash Logo (Sada)
nodes.rationale: App bootsplash logo asset; white logo mark on transparent background for launch screen

nodes.label: Bootsplash Logo (4x)
nodes.rationale: App launch bootsplash logo asset; renders on transparent/white background

nodes.label: moderateScale / fontScale
nodes.rationale: For one-off sizes with no token; design reference 375x812.

nodes.label: baseApi
nodes.rationale: Single RTK Query base with global error-handling baseQuery; all feature endpoints inject into it

nodes.label: navigationService
nodes.rationale: Imperative navigation usable from Redux middleware and API layer outside React

nodes.label: retryRegistry
nodes.rationale: Functions cannot be stored in Redux (breaks serialization), so retry callbacks are keyed and Redux stores only the key

nodes.label: useNetworkMonitor
nodes.rationale: Subscribes to netinfo and dispatches network error without needing an API call to trigger the snackbar

nodes.label: RootNavigator
nodes.rationale: Renders one screen per AppStatus to keep navigation declarative

nodes.label: domain index.ts public API
nodes.rationale: The only file other domains/app may import — enforces encapsulation of the bounded context.

nodes.label: app layer (composition root)
nodes.rationale: Composition root: providers, RootNavigator, Redux store assembly, bootstrap, app-shell screens. May import everything.

nodes.label: core layer (infrastructure)
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure with no UI knowledge or business rules; if it needs a domain, invert via callback/registry or move the type down into core.

nodes.label: domains layer (bounded contexts)
nodes.rationale: Business logic, one folder per bounded context; cross-domain imports only via @/domains/<y> public index.

nodes.label: shared layer (domain-agnostic)
nodes.rationale: Reusable domain-agnostic code (UI kit, context, utils, types); may import core only.

nodes.label: useAppBootstrap Boot Sequence
nodes.rationale: AppStatus enum resolved from MMKV on every launch so RootNavigator renders only the matching screen with no conditional logic elsewhere

nodes.label: SuperList
nodes.rationale: Built on flash-list v2 for all paginated/scrollable lists; never use raw FlatList on new screens

nodes.label: useSearchScreen
nodes.rationale: Reference implementation of the paginated list pattern

nodes.label: FloatingBottomBar
nodes.rationale: Slides in/out based on scroll direction and screen-driven visibility

nodes.label: Home Screen Pattern
nodes.rationale: Root must be plain View (never Animated.View) to avoid React 19 rendering issues; useFocusEffect resets scroll to prevent stale state on tab focus

nodes.label: Layout Component
nodes.rationale: Standard screen wrapper handling safe area, scroll, keyboard, status bar

nodes.label: Paginated List Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses LoadPhase enum and unwrap() single async flow to avoid double-render and stale aborted-request state

nodes.label: Theme Tokens
nodes.rationale: Raw colors/numbers live ONLY in src/core/theme/tokens/** to centralize visual values.

nodes.label: useStyles(factory, deps?)
nodes.rationale: Memoised StyleSheet built from theme.

nodes.label: useTheme()
nodes.rationale: Resolves colors/spacing/typography/etc from theme at runtime (light+dark).

nodes.label: UI Kit (@/shared/ui)
nodes.rationale: Single source of UI primitives; domain screens must never import raw react-native UI components.

nodes.label: Image
nodes.rationale: fast-image backed

nodes.label: 02 — Strict Design System
nodes.rationale: Enforces UI kit and token-only usage via ESLint to guarantee consistent theming (light/dark) and prevent hardcoded visual values.

nodes.label: Heroicons (@heroicons/react)
nodes.rationale: Fallback icon set when Phosphor lacks a suitable icon, keeping style consistent

nodes.label: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react)
nodes.rationale: Default icon library; icons.csv lists only common recommendations, not the full set

nodes.label: Token-driven Theming
nodes.rationale: Semantic color tokens mapped per theme avoid hardcoded per-screen hex values

nodes.label: Touch Target Minimum Rule
nodes.rationale: Meets accessibility and platform usability standards: >=44x44pt iOS, >=48x48dp Android

nodes.label: Icons & Visual Elements Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Emojis are font-dependent and inconsistent across platforms; vector icons scale cleanly and support theming and design tokens

nodes.label: Pre-Delivery Checklist
nodes.rationale: Verify UI quality before delivering App UI code (iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter)

hyperedges.label: One-way dependency direction: app → domains → shared → core
